# lol.trq.lazarus

> One jar that boots stock Minecraft Forge 1.8.9 on Java 17, 21 and 25: a replacement LaunchWrapper entrypoint, a
> Java agent that patches Forge, FML, Mixin 0.7 and old libraries as they load, a self-repairing bootstrap, and an
> installer for the official launcher. OptiFine keeps working. LGPL-3.0-or-later.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, how it works, build
- [docs/how-it-works.md](docs/how-it-works.md): launch sequence, every patch and the JDK change behind it
- [docs/compatibility.md](docs/compatibility.md): what is tested, known limitations
- [docs/launchers.md](docs/launchers.md): official launcher, Prism/MultiMC, custom launchers
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): errors and fixes
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): mental model, patterns that matter, traps
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md), [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md), [NOTICE](NOTICE.md)

## Core source

- [Lazarus](runtime/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/launch/Lazarus.java): entrypoint, LaunchClassLoader, tweaker chain
- [Bootstrap](runtime/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/launch/Bootstrap.java): relaunch with agent, class path, flags
- [LazarusAgent](runtime/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/agent/LazarusAgent.java): opens the JDK, installs patches
- [Patches](runtime/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/patch/Patches.java): the patch list
- [LegacyReflection](runtime/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/compat/LegacyReflection.java): `sun.reflect.ReflectionFactory` stand-in
- [Fields](runtime/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/compat/Fields.java): `static final` writes
- [ElfVersions](runtime/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/compat/ElfVersions.java): LWJGL Linux natives fix
- [VanillaInstall](runtime/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/install/VanillaInstall.java): official launcher install
- [libraries.json](runtime/src/main/resources/lol/trq/lazarus/libraries.json): launch profile contract

## Examples

- [PatchesTest](runtime/src/test/java/lol/trq/lazarus/patch/PatchesTest.java): each patch on synthetic bytecode
- [CompatTest](runtime/src/test/java/lol/trq/lazarus/compat/CompatTest.java): reflection stand-in, Pack200
- [LaunchTest](runtime/src/test/java/lol/trq/lazarus/launch/LaunchTest.java): arguments, class path repair
- [DevLaunch](harness/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/harness/DevLaunch.java): booting Forge 1.8.9 on any JDK
- [SmokeMod](smoke/src/main/java/lol/trq/lazarus/smoke/SmokeMod.java): main menu and world checks
